stories.title: Big Ten tumbles out of AP top 5 for first time since '21; Georgia, Utah remain 1-2
stories.summary: A weekend of Big Ten upsets left the conference without a team in the top five of the AP Top 25 college football poll for the first time since 2021.

stories.title: Steelers WR Metcalf ejected from game against Eagles
stories.summary: Steelers wide receiver DK Metcalf was ejected in the third quarter of Sunday's game against the Eagles for unsportsmanlike conduct.

stories.title: TCU fires coach Dykes just months after multiyear extension
stories.summary: TCU has fired coach Sonny Dykes, who led the Horned Frogs to an appearance in the 2023 CFP title game in his first season.

stories.title: Tom Jackson, who formed Hall of Fame ESPN tandem with Chris Berman, dies at 75
stories.summary: Tom Jackson, a foundational player on the Broncos "Orange Crush" defense and a fixture at ESPN as a Hall of Fame broadcaster, has died. He was 75.

stories.title: Auriemma: Haven't spoken with Staley since Final Four tiff
stories.summary: Geno Auriemma is downplaying any focus on his relationship with Dawn Staley before his Huskies face her Gamecocks this week.
